Half Marathon.note: Based on 4 clean race result(s). Reasonably grounded if based on a 10K+ result; more of a stretch if only projected from 5K.

Marathon.note: Based on 4 clean race result(s). CAVEAT: marathon projections from short-race data are unreliable — doesn't account for fuelling or sustained multi-hour effort. Rough ballpark only.

excluded_races.name: Lightning Bolt 10K
excluded_races.reason: First race back after off-season. Logged for history, but excluded from prediction — 3+ months old and early-season fitness isn't representative of current form for a race this far out.

excluded_races.name: Cotswold Way Relay (leg)
excluded_races.reason: Respiratory episode in heat. Relay leg, off-road and extremely hilly — not comparable to a flat standalone race. Excluded from Riegel projection.

zones.name: Easy / recovery
zones.purpose: Most of the week. Conversational - if in doubt, slower.

zones.name: Long run
zones.purpose: Sunday. Steady, not easy-plus - the last few km may drift quicker.

zones.name: Half marathon (goal)
zones.purpose: Cheltenham race pace. Race-specific blocks late in the build.

zones.name: Threshold / tempo
zones.purpose: Comfortably hard, ~1hr race pace. The Saturday session.

zones.name: 10K pace
zones.purpose: The '10K effort' in interval sessions - 1km reps sit here.

zones.name: Interval / VO2max
zones.purpose: 3K race pace. Hard 800m-1km reps with full recovery.

zones.name: Reps / strides
zones.purpose: 1500m pace. 200-400m reps and strides - speed, not stamina.

training_paces.basis: Derived from 4 clean race result(s) via the same Riegel projection as the time predictions, so these update themselves whenever a new race is logged.
training_paces.caveat: Guides, not gospel. Heat, hills, wind and fatigue all justify running slower than the table on any given day - effort beats pace. Super shoes flatter pace by roughly 5-8 sec/km, so a session in racers is not directly comparable.

key_sessions_note: Logged for reference only — not converted into a predicted time. Converting interval-rep pace to race pace has no reliable formula; use your own judgement on what these sessions suggest.
